scope: Align existing live implementation capability selector with qualified safe-time task and registered exact policy; retain original task/policy history and authority gates.
riskAnalysis: Single advertised objective switch; no authority, source grammar, token or execution permission expansion. Old contracts frozen and providerdefaultUNCERTAIN remains. RealUI dispatch fixture tests exact newpolicy canonical journal, one-run and cleanup.

threatModel.assets: Exact live task selection, historical source contracts and preserved owner task/release authority.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Advertised capability versus actual selected task, registered provider policy and server-side authorization.
threatModel.abuseCases: Stale v5 selection, wrong policy, forged source, generic approval fallback or duplicated run after acknowledgment loss.
threatModel.mitigations: One exact safe-time objective, registry/policy assertion, realUI saved-grant one-dispatch case, immutable oldguidance and unchanged default UNCERTAIN.

defects.rootCause: Live capability selector still advertised v5, so actual UI admission could not select the registered safe-time v6 task.
defects.detectionGap: Prior contract/lifecycle tests covered v6 descriptor but did not assert advertised live capability alignment.
defects.regression: Exact capability/policy assertion, frozen old v5 guidance and actual UI Prepare/Run/revoke one-dispatch case;60targeted checks passed.
defects.historicalPrevention: Verify actual owner control selection against exact intended registry policy before creating configuration or paid grants.

rollback: Restore prior advertised selector only via reviewed feature commit and keep paidexecution off; preserve old tasks, canceled refresh and all failed evidence.
